Quick note on the immigration side based on the candidate's profile: principal petition (H-1B transfer / employer sponsorship) + spouse derivative typically:
- Legal fees (standard engagement): $3,200–$4,200
- Filing fees + USCIS (including premium processing if requested): $1,500–$2,000
- Misc. admin (notarizations, translation): ~ $150–$300

Total estimated employer-borne cost: $4,850–$6,500. Premium processing shortens adjudication to ~15 calendar days; otherwise expect 6–10 weeks depending on service center.

We can structure counsel engagement so Redwood is invoiced directly. If Redwood prefers reimbursement to candidate, counsel will still invoice candidate unless we sign an engagement letter naming Redwood as the client.
